title: Constitution of India, 1950
summary: Foundational constitutional text covering fundamental rights, directive principles, institutions, legislative powers and the administration of justice.
source: Legislative Department — Constitution of India

title: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
summary: Principal substantive criminal law replacing the Indian Penal Code, subject to its commencement provisions and applicable transitional rules.
source: Ministry of Home Affairs / Gazette notification

title: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
summary: Criminal procedure framework covering investigation, inquiry, trial and related criminal process; check commencement and transitional provisions.
source: Ministry of Home Affairs / Gazette notification

title: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023
summary: Evidence law addressing relevancy, proof and evidentiary treatment including electronic and digital records.
source: Ministry of Home Affairs / Gazette notification

title: General Clauses Act, 1897
summary: General statutory interpretation and construction provisions that apply unless the context or subject indicates otherwise.
source: India Code — official legislation repository

title: Indian Contract Act, 1872
summary: Core rules on formation, consent, consideration, performance, breach, indemnity, guarantee, bailment, pledge and agency.
source: India Code — Indian Contract Act PDF

title: Specific Relief Act, 1963
summary: Remedies for civil rights, including specific performance, substituted performance, injunctions and declaratory relief, subject to statutory limits.
source: India Code — official legislation repository

title: Sale of Goods Act, 1930
summary: Rules for contracts of sale of goods, including conditions, warranties, transfer of property, delivery and unpaid seller rights.
source: India Code — official legislation repository

title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996
summary: Framework for domestic and international commercial arbitration, enforcement of awards and conciliation, as amended.
source: India Code — official legislation repository

title: Insurance Act, 1938
summary: Principal statute regulating insurers and insurance business in India; read with later amendments and IRDAI regulations.
source: Department of Financial Services — Insurance Act, 1938

title: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999
summary: Establishes IRDAI and its statutory regulatory framework for supervision and development of the insurance sector.
source: Department of Financial Services — Insurance Acts and Policies

title: IRDAI (Protection of Policyholders’ Interests, Operations and Allied Matters of Insurers) Regulations, 2024
summary: Regulatory requirements concerning fair treatment of prospects and policyholders, insurer and distribution-channel conduct, and policyholder servicing.
source: Gazette of India — IRDAI Regulations, 2024 (official PDF)

title: IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations, 2024
summary: Regulatory framework for insurance products; product design, approval, filing and related insurer obligations should be checked against current circulars.
source: Department of Financial Services — Acts and Policies

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019
summary: Consumer rights and redress framework, including consumer commissions, product liability and the Central Consumer Protection Authority.
source: India Code — Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (official PDF)

title: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020
summary: Consumer-facing obligations for e-commerce entities and marketplace/inventory models, including disclosures and grievance handling; check amendments.
source: Department of Consumer Affairs — E-Commerce Rules (official Gazette PDF)

title: Legal Metrology Act, 2009 and Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
summary: Standards for weights and measures and prescribed declarations for packaged commodities; check the latest amendments and applicable exemptions.
source: Department of Consumer Affairs — Legal Metrology and Packaged Commodities Rules

title: Consumer Protection (Direct Selling) Rules, 2021
summary: Consumer protection requirements for direct-selling entities and direct sellers, including disclosures, grievance redressal and prohibited practices.
source: Department of Consumer Affairs — Consumer Protection Rules

title: Right to Information Act, 2005
summary: Provides a statutory mechanism for access to information held by public authorities, subject to exemptions, procedure and time limits.
source: India Code — official legislation repository

title: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
summary: Rights and entitlements framework including accessibility and communication-related duties; apply relevant rules and standards to the context.
source: India Code — official legislation repository

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 — consumer rights and redress
summary: Supports accessible consumer redress and protection against unfair trade practices; this entry is a thematic index to the Act, not a separate law.
source: India Code — Consumer Protection Act, 2019

title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
summary: Indian framework for processing digital personal data, balancing individual data-protection rights with lawful processing; commencement is provision-specific.
source: India Code — Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023

title: Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025
summary: Rules made under the DPDP Act with phased commencement; verify which rules are in force on the date relevant to the matter.
source: MeitY — Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 (official Gazette PDF)

title: Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011
summary: Legacy IT Act rules concerning sensitive personal data and reasonable security practices; assess their current interaction with the DPDP framework and commencement notifications.
source: India Code / MeitY — Information Technology Act and rules repository

title: Information Technology Act, 2000
summary: Core statute for electronic records and signatures, specified cyber offences, intermediary-related provisions and electronic transactions.
source: India Code — Information Technology Act, 2000

title: CERT-In Directions under section 70B(6), 2022
summary: Cybersecurity directions covering specified incident reporting, time synchronisation, logs and information requests for covered entities.
source: CERT-In — Directions under section 70B of the IT Act

title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 — digital processing
summary: Relevant to AI and automated systems when they process digital personal data; this thematic entry does not create a separate AI-specific statute.
source: India Code — Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023

title: Advocates Act, 1961
summary: Statutory framework for the legal profession, enrolment, Bar Councils and disciplinary jurisdiction, read with applicable Bar Council rules.
source: India Code — official legislation repository

title: Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987
summary: Establishes legal services authorities and provides for legal aid and Lok Adalats, subject to eligibility and statutory conditions.
source: National Legal Services Authority / India Code

title: Bar Council of India Rules
summary: Professional standards and conduct rules for advocates; consult the current official consolidated rules and notifications before use.
source: Bar Council of India — official website

title: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
summary: General procedural framework for civil suits, pleadings, service, interim relief, trial, judgments and execution, subject to amendments and local rules.
source: India Code — official legislation repository

title: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 — evidence and electronic records
summary: Rules on evidence and proof, including provisions relevant to electronic and digital records; check applicable commencement and transitional rules.
source: Ministry of Home Affairs — official Gazette notification

title: Official Languages Act, 1963
summary: Statutory provisions concerning continued use of English for Union official purposes and related language arrangements; does not make every translation authoritative.
source: India Code — official legislation repository
